group.passage: What do you eat for lunch at school? Around the world, the answer can be very different. Many countries serve meals at school so that children get healthy food every day, but each country does it in its own way. The table below compares school lunches in Japan, France, the United States, and Taiwan. In Japan, school lunch is seen as part of education. The Japanese even have a word for this idea: shokuiku, or “food education.” Menus are often planned by nutritionists, and the meals are usually cooked from scratch. There is no cafeteria in most schools, so students eat in their own classrooms. They take turns serving the food, and before they eat, the whole class gives thanks together. In France, lunch is served in the school canteen, and it is a meal with several parts. The town plans the menu and usually posts it online. Since 2019, every school canteen has had to serve a vegetarian menu at least once a week. In the United States, a national program has provided school lunches since 1946. Each lunch is built from five food groups. Children from families with low incomes can get their lunch for free or at a lower price, while other students pay a low full price. Lunch in Taiwan looks a little like lunch in Japan. Students often serve one another and eat in their classrooms. The Ministry of Education sets rules for how healthy the meals must be, and anyone can check each school's daily menu online. In 2026, Taipei and several other cities began to offer free lunches at public elementary and junior high schools. Lunch may look different from place to place, but in every one of these countries, it is about more than just filling hungry stomachs.

translation_zh.text:
你在學校午餐吃什麼？在世界各地，答案可能大不相同。許多國家在學校供餐，讓孩子每天都能吃到健康的食物，但每個國家的做法都不一樣。下面的表格比較了日本、法國、美國和台灣的學校午餐。
在日本，學校午餐被視為教育的一部分。日本人甚至有一個詞來指這個觀念：「食育」，也就是「飲食教育」。菜單常由營養師規劃，餐點通常是從頭開始烹煮的。大多數學校沒有餐廳，所以學生在自己的教室裡用餐。他們輪流打菜，開動前全班會一起表達感謝。
在法國，午餐在學校餐廳供應，而且是由好幾個部分組成的一餐。菜單由市鎮規劃，通常會公布在網路上。自 2019 年起，每一間學校餐廳每週都必須至少供應一次素食菜單。
在美國，一項全國性的計畫自 1946 年起就提供學校午餐。每一份午餐都由五大類食物組成。來自低收入家庭的孩子可以免費或以較低的價格吃午餐，其他學生則支付不高的全額費用。
台灣的午餐有點像日本的午餐。學生常常互相打菜，並在教室裡用餐。教育部訂定餐點必須多健康的規範，任何人都可以在網路上查看每所學校每天的菜單。2026 年，台北和其他幾個城市開始在公立國小和國中提供免費午餐。
各地的午餐看起來或許不同，但在這幾個國家裡，午餐的意義都不只是填飽肚子而已。
